name: Dinari USD+
launchPhaseDetail: Publicly issued; active tracking awaits the Safety Score new-asset evidence gate. Price and supply lanes pass, but 17 own open questions and the Mint Authority control inventory remain unresolved.

milestones.title: Dinari announces USD+ availability on Ethereum mainnet
milestones.description: Dinari's launch announcement states that USD+ and stUSD+ are available on Ethereum mainnet with a public minting and redemption app. This dates the instrument's public issuance, before the current replacement deployments; it does not establish the current token's control inventory.

listingStatusReview.reason: DefiLlama 465 price/supply pass. Safety Score new-asset evidence gate blocks active admission: 17 own open questions; unresolved Mint Authority control inventory (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Plume). Close with pinned source/control proof, gap closure and passing admission receipt.

oneLiner: Dinari's Treasury-backed dollar distributes yield through daily rebasing; eligible account holders redeem through the issuer in USDC.
collateral: Dinari describes reserves consisting mostly of short-term U.S. Treasuries with smaller bank-deposit and accepted-stablecoin holdings. The public treasury rosters include tokenized USFR shares but establish neither holdings nor portfolio weights.
pegMechanism: The current guide describes minting with USDC or USDT and redemption at one dollar per USD+, paid in USDC, with advertised settlement in 0 to 3 days. Direct redemption requires an approved Dinari account and is restricted by jurisdiction; the terms permit compliance and partner delays. Daily rebases increase token balances while the unit targets one dollar.

proofOfReserves.provider: Dinari publishes an issuer-operated dashboard and eligible treasury-token rosters; no current USD+-specific independent reserve report or named attestor was verified.

notices.title: Yield documentation differs
notices.message: The current USD+ guide describes direct daily rebasing, while the published terms still describe rewards through Staked USD+. The current deployment and its yield controls require separate review from the former USD+ token.
